fit_metadata.search_kind: Pair differences divided by integers1:32; free-offset and zero-offset fits.
fit_metadata.uncertainty_scope: OLS conditional on selected inliers/integers; not a global hypothesis-test confidence interval.
fit_metadata.source_identity: Unknown. A repeated comb can be clock, packet structure, periodic clutter or a mixture.
fit_metadata.training_support_policy: Only RF groups repeated in at least two independently tuned centers.
fit_metadata.alias_warning: Small spacings and their multiples may describe the same finite set. Candidate ranking does not resolve subharmonic aliases.
